about: The interaction contract as data (Prompt 155; INTERACTION.md is the prose). tests/interactionContract.test.js holds every registered surface to it. Prompt 161 folds the surfaces into the navigation inventory; Prompt 278 activates the pending checks.

actions.nudge: Move a quantity or an aim by one step; Alt is a quarter of a step, Shift is four.
actions.along: Previous and next along an ordered set (Left, Right).
actions.across: Previous and next across the set's series (Up, Down).
actions.page: A surface-declared jump along the set (PageUp, PageDown).
actions.confirm: Commit what is aimed or toggle the focused item (Enter; Space where the item is a toggle).
actions.cancel: Abandon, clear or close the innermost thing (Escape).
actions.zoom: Zoom a camera in or out where a surface has one (+ or =, -).

noBareKey.openTable: The surface's Table control, reached with Tab. T is the theme everywhere.
noBareKey.openDisclosure: Enter or Space on the disclosure's summary, which the browser provides.

meanings: extend the selection (plot, image and table selection)
conflicts.resolution: Shift is the coarse size on a surface that nudges a number. A selection surface keeps Shift to extend and uses PageUp and PageDown for its coarse step. The 3-D camera keeps Shift to pan; a proposed rename (pan on Ctrl) is a decision for Carl, because it changes a binding students and instructors may have been taught.

meanings: pans the view left (A, W, S, D beside the arrows)
conflicts.resolution: One press of A did both. Measured on 2026-10-19 with a type armed: the view moved 40 px and a keyboard placement began. The rename that removes it (A no longer pans while a type is armed; the arrow keys always pan) is the visible train PR that follows this one.

The two never share a page. The contract assigns + and - to zoom, so the sandbox, which has no keyboard zoom, has a gap (interaction.keyboard.sandbox-zoom); moving speed to another pair is a decision for Carl.

surfaces.name: The sandbox: placing a body
surfaces.primaryTask: Place a body and throw it.

keyboard.title: placing a body from the keyboard

singlePointer.title: a typed launch is the recorded drag

announcement.title: the aim is announced, and so is the placement

surfaces.name: The sandbox: pan and zoom
surfaces.primaryTask: Move the view and change its scale.

keyboard.title: W, A, S, D and the arrows pan

notApplicable.announcement: Panning moves a picture, not a value: nothing changes that a reader would be told.

surfaces.name: A plot: the readout cursor
surfaces.primaryTask: Read a value off a curve.

keyboard.title: the readout is reachable and operable from the keyboard

singlePointer.title: a plot readout needs no drag

announcement.title: the plot cursor announces where it is

surfaces.name: The Observatory: choosing rows, points and pixels

singlePointer.title: rows are chosen by clicking, without a drag

announcement.title: a selection in the plot is the selection in the table

surfaces.name: The 3-D lab: the camera
surfaces.primaryTask: Look at the system from another side.

keyboard.title: the keyboard alone plays, orbits, zooms and picks a look

singlePointer.title: a preset view is chosen without orbiting

notApplicable.announcement: An orbit or zoom moves a picture, not a value: the state tables carry the numbers and do not change.

drags.gesture: Press where the body goes and drag to throw it; the length of the drag is its speed.
alternatives: Precise placement: a form that takes the position, velocity and mass as numbers and calls the same placeBody().
Keyboard aim: A arms it, the arrows aim, Enter commits, with the drag's own velocity expression.

drags.gesture: Drag empty space to move the view.
alternatives: The arrow keys and W, A, S, D pan; Home resets.

drags.gesture: Drag across a plot to select the rows under it.
alternatives: Click a row of the table to select it; Shift-click selects the run to another row.
Click the plot to focus the nearest row.
drags.note: A run without a drag or a held modifier is not offered to a touch reader; interaction.single-pointer.observatory-run records it.

drags.gesture: Drag across the image to select the pixels in the box.
alternatives: Click a pixel to focus it; the table lists every pixel as a row that a click selects.

drags.gesture: Drag on a lesson's picture (the H-R diagram, a phase plot) to set the value under the pointer.
alternatives: A click sets the value as the first press of a drag does.
The arrow keys step the value, following the picture's own axes.

drags.gesture: Drag the scene to orbit, wheel to zoom.
alternatives: The View select offers named views and the Projection select changes the projection; neither needs a drag.
Arrow keys orbit, Shift pans, + and - zoom.

drags.gesture: Drag the observer's handle on the sandbox canvas to change the viewing angle.
drags.note: No numeric or keyboard control for the angle was found in index.html or js/lightCurve.js.

drags.gesture: Drag the header of a pinned inspector card or the 3-D view window to move it; drag the 3-D window's corner to resize it.

unregistered: Every other surface in the navigation inventory: Prompt 161 registers them and lists their failures as pending checks.

dragSites.about: Every module under js/ that listens for pointermove, mousemove or touchmove, and what it is. A module not listed fails tests/interactionContract.test.js until it is registered here.

js/lecture.js.exempt: Shows the cursor again when the pointer moves; not a gesture.

js/main.js.exempt: The double-tap recognizer: one finger, no path.

js/plot/chart.js.exempt: The hover readout; the pointer only points.

js/render.js.exempt: Marks the frame loop busy for a moment; not a gesture.
